top_choice_rationale: P003 credits the physical-chemical principle that multivalent interactions drive biomolecular phase separation into membraneless compartments: P-granule liquid behaviour (Hyman, Brangwynne) plus Rosen's measurable phase diagram for defined multivalent proteins. It is quantitative, reproduced in vitro and in cells, and widely adopted. The citation is limited to the principle, so it survives open questions about which in vivo assemblies are truly phase separated. It also gives physical chemistry a place that the base-editing and sequencing proposals do not. The cost is leaving out Pappu and Mittag, which I cannot defend on scientific grounds. Next is P002, for clean attribution and chemistry in the cytosine and adenine editors. Then the Liu-plus-Pd C-N coupling pairing, and the Liu-plus-sequencing pairing, which excludes the 454 lineage. Perovskites are real but still maturing. No award is last because several candidates are mature enough to award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; the only link is soft-matter proximity to B007 (lipid/protein self-assembly and phase behaviour), which is a field overlap and not a personal tie to any proposed laureate.
